book_title: 小蓝本高中卷4 均值不等式与柯西不等式
stem_md: 设 $\triangle ABC$ 的三个内角为 $\alpha, \beta, \gamma$, 则 $P = \frac{1}{2}R^2(\sin 2\alpha + \sin 2\beta + \sin 2\gamma)$. 由平均值不等式, 得 $16Q^3 = 2R^6[\sin(\beta + \gamma) + \sin(\alpha + \gamma) + \sin(\alpha + \beta)]^3 \geq 2R^6 \cdot 27 \sin(\beta + \gamma) \sin(\alpha + \gamma) \sin(\alpha + \beta) = \frac{27}{2}R^6[\sin(\alpha + \beta + \gamma) + \sin(\alpha + \beta - \gamma) + \sin 2\alpha + \sin 2\beta + \sin 2\gamma] = \frac{27}{2}R^6(\sin 2\alpha + \sin 2\beta + \sin 2\gamma) = 27R^4P$.
original_text_md: 设 $\triangle ABC$ 的三个内角为 $\alpha, \beta, \gamma$, 则 $P = \frac{1}{2}R^2(\sin 2\alpha + \sin 2\beta + \sin 2\gamma)$. 由平均值不等式, 得 $16Q^3 = 2R^6[\sin(\beta + \gamma) + \sin(\alpha + \gamma) + \sin(\alpha + \beta)]^3 \geq 2R^6 \cdot 27 \sin(\beta + \gamma) \sin(\alpha + \gamma) \sin(\alpha + \beta) = \frac{27}{2}R^6[\sin(\alpha + \beta + \gamma) + \sin(\alpha + \beta - \gamma) + \sin 2\alpha + \sin 2\beta + \sin 2\gamma] = \frac{27}{2}R^6(\sin 2\alpha + \sin 2\beta + \sin 2\gamma) = 27R^4P$.
